title: EnglishFlow Per-Asset Licensing and Human QA Dossier Schema
description: Formal schema for per-asset licensing evidence, voice synthesis metadata, human speech QA verification, and production release distribution approval.

contentId.description: Canonical UUID matching learning_contents table and catalog

storageKey.description: Relative storage key, e.g. curated/dictation-a1-001.wav or /api/v1/media/audio/curated/...

transcriptSha256.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash of authoritative canonical transcript text

audioSha256.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash of approved audio byte stream. Must be null until approved bytes exist.

provider.description: Synthesis or recording provider (e.g. AWS_POLLY_CANDIDATE, ELEVENLABS_CANDIDATE, HUMAN_STUDIO)

voiceId.description: Voice identifier, e.g. Joanna, Matthew, Amy

licenseEvidenceRef.description: Reference path to legal terms, commercial license, or dev restriction document

distributionApproved.description: Explicit boolean flag. Must be false by default until legally certified.

reviewerIdentity.description: Human legal or security reviewer identifier. Must be null by default.

humanQaVerified.description: Explicit boolean flag confirming native cadence, phonetic clarity, and lack of artifacting.

humanReviewerIdentity.description: Human linguist or QA engineer identifier. Must be null by default.

reviewedAt.description: Timestamp of formal review signoff. Must be null by default.
